items.title: 61428_Red Callender oral history interview
items.q: There was another piano player, Lannie Scott, and several other guys that I don't remember, but Tatum stuck out in my mind.

ctx.x: I didn't believe any of what he was doing was possible. There was another piano player, Lannie Scott, and several other guys that I don't remember, but Tatum stuck out in my mind. And he played "Tiger Rag" and all those things... Which incidentally, I have a tape on those things from Tatum from 1935 to '42. This guy Arnold Lovich in New York is a Tatum historian, and he sends me these things.

Anyhow, Tatum was so fantastic, and when he died, what, twenty-two years later I was working with him. He was only 46 when he died. And I had many albums with him during the last years. But this "Tiger Rag", he did it the same way twenty years later as he did then, and it was still fantastic. Nobody could touch him. I had forgotten to mention him. That's when I first heard him.
